answer.summary: Verify the explicit reporting of the per-interval retention rate in Section 4.1 of Kumar et al., 2024 under a 50-token update interval and 100-token budget size.
answer.content: This investigation confirms whether the paper directly reports a per-interval retention rate metric under exactly specified conditions: 50-token update interval and 100-token token budget. The focus is strictly on the source's explicit data to ensure empirical grounding and alignment with the reviewed requirements for fidelity and verifiability in memory retention metrics. No extrapolation or inference beyond the reported values is permitted.
